name: addDamage
description: Master damage application pipeline — processes all damage/heal events for a unit each frame
overview: Called once per frame with an array of health events. Applies PvP reduction, shield absorption, death prevention, and HP modification.

pre_damage_phase.heal_reduction: REDUCE_HEAL buffs can further reduce healing
pre_damage_phase.triggers: HP_Heal effect triggers fire after recovery

damage_types.description: These HealthTypes go through the full damage pipeline

display_types.description: These HealthTypes only log/display, no HP change

damage_pipeline_steps.name: PvP Damage Reduction
damage_pipeline_steps.note: injuryReduce is level-based PvP reduction factor; 1 in PvE

damage_pipeline_steps.name: Season PvE Damage Bonus
damage_pipeline_steps.note: Only applies to defending team (teamId=1) during season PvE

damage_pipeline_steps.name: Shield Absorption
damage_pipeline_steps.description: If unit has shields (SHIELD buffs) and shieldHp > 0
damage_pipeline_steps.formula: For each shield: absorbed = shield.onShieldAction(damage); damage = roundInt(damage - absorbed)

damage_pipeline_steps.name: Block Absorption
damage_pipeline_steps.description: If unit has BLOCK buffs, they absorb remaining damage
damage_pipeline_steps.formula: For each block buff: absorbed = block.onShieldAction(damage); damage = roundInt(damage - absorbed)

damage_pipeline_steps.name: Death Prevention Chain
damage_pipeline_steps.description: Checked in order: Time Reversal → Remake HP → Immune Death

order.name: TIME_REVERSAL
order.description: Checks if HP dropped below threshold, reverses time if so

order.name: REMAKE_HP
order.description: If Time Reversal didn't trigger, checks and restores HP

order.name: IMMUNE_DEATH
order.description: If neither triggered, prevents death entirely

damage_pipeline_steps.result: If immuneDeath or remakeLock active: currenHp = max(currenHp, 1)

damage_pipeline_steps.name: Record Damage
damage_pipeline_steps.description: RECORD_DAMAGE buffs log cumulative damage taken

damage_pipeline_steps.name: HP Change Triggers
damage_pipeline_steps.description: totalDamage accumulates; HP_CHANGE_TRIGER and TOTAL_DAMAGE_TRIGGER buffs fire

steps.name: Heal Reduction
steps.formula: For each REDUCE_HEAL buff: healAmount = buff.onCalHeal(healAmount)

steps: Record protection: if recording and this is the recorded winner, currenHp = max(currenHp, 1)
Calculate net HP change from frame start
If damaged and not controlled: flash model, potentially trigger Hit state

buff_types_involved.REMAKE_HP: Restores HP when it drops too low
buff_types_involved.TIME_REVERSAL: Resets state when HP drops below threshold
buff_types_involved.HP_CHANGE_TRIGER: Triggers effects based on HP change
buff_types_involved.TOTAL_DAMAGE_TRIGGER: Triggers effects based on cumulative damage
